note: Two names in the batch resolve to one operating entity: 'V-TECH AGRO INDUSTRIES' has a full customs record (41 shipments, 4 counterparties, 8 port lanes, latest 2025-06-24), while the bare slug 'v-tech-enterprises' on ImportKey returns an empty shell page ("Loading...", no counters) and 'v-tech-enterprises-vijay-singh-kashyap' likewise returns no records — so the promoter name VIJAY SINGH KASHYAP is not corroborated by any shipment record seen. Export activity is real and dated, but it is entirely land-border trade to Nepal in HS 84369100 (poultry-keeping machinery parts: nipple drinkers, curtain winches, layer cages), which is consistent with the claimed agro/poultry-equipment business and NOT with the declared HS 843629 nor with the claimed industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) — the industry label appears to be a classification error on our side, not a company defect. Per rule 3 the company is retained and the HS code should be corrected to the factual 84369100 (verdict accepted_hs_corrected), with the caveat that 843629 is not what was shipped. Revenue and export value: null — ImportKey free view exposes no FOB/invoice values, only BOL numbers. Second sources (volza, eximpedia) returned HTTP 403 and the search backend was unreachable, so corroboration rests on a single source; the 41-shipment counter versus 5 visible rows is a paywall truncation, not a contradiction. Domestic supply: no evidence found either way — do not read the inbound China import as domestic sales.
